# KeyValueGrid

A grid of labels and values for detail views, with mono values for data, copyable IDs and an en dash for anything missing.

`SongNodes.KeyValueGrid` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.KeyValueGrid items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.KeyValueGrid" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (KeyValueGridProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `{ label: string; value: ReactNode \| null; copy?: string; mono?: boolean }[]` | Label/value pairs; null values render as an en dash. |
| `layout` | `"single" \| "two" \| "stacked"` | Layout: one pair per row (default), two pairs per row, or stacked tiles. |
